privacySections.title: 1. Data collected
privacySections.body: CEan'sCare collects the information you voluntarily provide: health profile (age, weight, blood pressure, medical history), daily measurement logs, AI consultation messages and subscription details. No health data is collected without your explicit consent.

privacySections.title: 2. Use of data
privacySections.body: Your data is used exclusively to personalize your AI analyses, nutrition plans and wellness recommendations, as well as to manage your Premium subscription and teleconsultation appointments.

privacySections.title: 3. Local storage
privacySections.body: Most of your health data is stored locally on your device (localStorage). It is only transmitted to the server during an AI analysis, over an encrypted TLS connection.

privacySections.title: 4. Sharing with third parties
privacySections.body: We never sell your data. AI processing is performed by our providers (Google Gemini, OpenRouter) who commit to not using your data for other purposes. Your contact details are only shared with a practitioner after booking an appointment.

privacySections.title: 5. Security
privacySections.body: Communications are TLS-encrypted and our servers follow security best practices. In the event of a data breach, you will be notified as soon as possible.

privacySections.title: 6. Your rights
privacySections.body: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase and object to the processing of your data. Contact us at privacy@ceanscare.app to exercise these rights.

termsSections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
termsSections.body: By using CEan'sCare, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

termsSections.title: 2. Service provided
termsSections.body: CEan'sCare is a wellness assistance platform that connects you with health professionals. The application in no way replaces an in-person medical consultation.

termsSections.title: 3. Medical disclaimer
termsSections.body: AI-assisted analyses, diagnoses and recommendations are provided for informational purposes only. In case of severe symptoms or emergency, immediately contact emergency services or your physician.

termsSections.title: 4. User obligations
termsSections.body: You agree to provide accurate information and not to use the service for fraudulent purposes. Doctors agree to provide valid professional credentials.

termsSections.title: 5. Premium subscription
termsSections.body: The Premium subscription is billed monthly or yearly and can be cancelled at any time. Payment is processed by our secure payment provider.

termsSections.title: 6. Liability
termsSections.body: CEan'sCare strives to ensure service availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted operation. Our liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.

termsSections.title: 7. Contact
termsSections.body: For any question regarding these terms, contact us at support@ceanscare.app.
